title: Genuinely helps
body: No idea what I exactly like about dailyhabits.xyz but being able to make complete use of the tool  (and serve the purpose) within 1 minute of signing up is truly amazing. As this only requires less than 10seconds of attention per day, it’s pretty convenient for someone like me who usually fools himself into thinking that “I cannot follow through on yet another new thing because it’s too much commitment and I already have a infinite amount of tasks which require my attention and I’ve not started on it, yet.”
author: PhoenixIsoYoru

title: App exclusive for paid users
body:
Found this app while searching for an Habit tracker.

Upon installing, it asked to create an account. After creating an account, you realise the app is for paid users. 

Would have appreciated a heads up before I created the account.
author: Raghav_K

title: Simple, clean, effective
body: Worked for me to have an app that does what it says on the tin.
author: Barry Engelherd

title: Helped track some new habits
body: I wanted to get started with incorporating two new things into my day and this app helped in keeping a track of it! It’s very easy to use and has kept me on track so far.
